subject: Data Engineering
title: Data Quality SLAs
description: A short lesson to help you apply Data Quality SLAs.

hook.text: The CEO expects the revenue dashboard to be accurate to within 1% by 8 AM. That's a data quality SLA.

buildup.text: Quality SLAs define measurable thresholds: freshness, accuracy, completeness, and availability.

discovery.text: SLAs create accountability. When breached, someone is responsible for investigating and fixing the issue.

twist.text: Setting SLAs too tight causes alert fatigue. Too loose renders them meaningless. Calibration is key.

climax.text: Start with generous SLAs, measure actual performance, then tighten as your pipelines stabilize.

punchline.text: Promise what you can deliver. Then deliver more.

quiz.question: What should data quality SLAs define?
options: Measurable thresholds for freshness, accuracy, and completeness
